contracts: The Type-0x2A player-collision dispatch entry at 0x001D66 points to the shared ActorShared_PlayerCollisionHandler body at 0x001AE9C6.
The same technical type is independently established by the upper-route movement stream, animation stream, and actor template, so the dispatch pointer is attached to VERTICAL_BOB_OBJECT.
The original numeric dispatch name remains an alias.
limitations: The shared handler body is also selected by other technical dispatch entries; those entries remain numeric until selector-specific behavior or entity evidence distinguishes them.
Vertical-bob is a recovered behavioral role, not a claim about an official in-game name.
